expectations.text: Produced a spreadsheet in Downloads with the app's import columns
expectations.evidence: columns: question, a, b, c, d, e, answer, explanation, category1, category2

expectations.text: The file parses through the app's own importer with zero rejected rows
Every question has 5 non-empty options as the user asked
Every question has an explanation of at least 60 characters
Correct answers are spread across letters (no single letter above 45%)
category1 values exactly match app chapter names (e.g. 'Neonatology', 'GIT', 'Haematology')
Questions are clinically accurate with a single defensible answer
